title: The Greatest Miracle
description: Gain the **Invoke the Divine** Cleric Starting Move if you don't already have it, except your deity's Domain is **Life**. Choose your deity's worshippers and enemies as detailed in the Move.

outcomes.text: Add Life to your deity's domains. Is this a new aspect of your deity, a result of your unique connection to them, or something else?

submoves.title: Battlefield Medic
submoves.description: Once per session, when you endanger yourself to protect or heal someone, gain 1 Depth with your deity.

submoves.title: Cure Wounds
submoves.description: Whenever you **Cast a Spell** to heal someone (e.g. restore HP, cure disease, etc.), treat the **mag** as if it were 1 lower when comparing it to your Casting Stat.

outcomes.text: When someone else **Faces Death** in your presence, you may parley with Death and grant the agonizing character access to the following option:
bullets: Revivified — You're no longer Helpless and you recover half your max HP. You still lock a Condition after **Facing Death**.

outcomes.text: If they choose this option, you cannot use this Move again until you've settled your deal with Death.

title: I'll Carry it For You
description: When you **touch someone else and offer yourself as a sacrifice**, erase 1 Depth with your deity then do either or both:

outcomes.text: Choose any Conditions they have; they clear those Conditions and you mark them
Choose any amount of HP they are missing; they restore it, and you lose them
No one will attack you directly and unprovoked, unless they've seen you fight or have a score to settle. When you **Pull Strings**, you get access to the following approach:
bullets: If you implore them to turn away from violence, they might leave now or change their mind later.

title: Mass Cure Wounds
description: When you **proclaim your faith**, erase 1 Depth with your deity to restore half of your and your **close** allies maximum HP (rounded down).
